request: Read the single already-running AI Core in-Gate physical 2→3→2 acceptance and publish bounded result, no model start, no Gateway/DebugAI changes; preserve source-vs-runtime distinction.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
x=/run/ai-core/uds-handoff-406d
s=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate cat "$x.status")
if test "$s" = DONE; then
 rc=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate cat "$x.exit")
 body=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate cat "$x.result" | tail -1)
 msg="AI_CORE_UDS_HANDOFF_406D_FINAL SOURCE=406d79c7aa60a13e05dd08e85b581604b9418a6d EXIT=$rc $body"
else
 v=$(docker exec ai-core-model-gate python3 -c 'import os,json,urllib.request;h={"Authorization":"Bearer "+os.environ["AI_CORE_API_KEY"]};p=urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:18184/internal/handoff/status",headers=h);a=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(p,timeout=8));print("RESIDENT="+str(len(a["resident"]))+" ACTIVE="+str(sum(a["active"].values()))+" HANDOFF="+str(bool(a["handoff"]))+" RECOVERY="+str(len(a["recovery_pending"])))')
 msg="AI_CORE_UDS_HANDOFF_406D_PROGRESS $s $v"
fi
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq '.html_url' >/dev/null
echo AI_CORE_UDS_HANDOFF_RESULT_RECORDED=YES
